classification.resume: This record documents a parliamentary question by National Councillor Jean-Luc Addor during the 2016 autumn session of the Swiss National Council, concerning the revision of the EU firearms directive and opposing any tightening of Swiss gun legislation. It is a transcript of a question-and-answer exchange within the official session protocols. The record is part of the official minutes of the National Council.
